items.detail: The supplied donor Vorkath implementation contains no explicit sound-effect IDs. Revision-240 sequence-embedded audio remains intact, but standalone OSRS sound IDs and exact trigger ticks were not inventively guessed.
OpenRune does not expose a complete Dragon Slayer II quest-state implementation. VorkathAccessPolicy is the single injection point and currently permits access so the boss remains testable.
The prompt calls the donor Reason 231, while the supplied package decodes as build 229.1. No target cache decision relies on the label.
